filters.description: Structured business filter map. Keys and nested keys use lowerCamelCase equivalents of Prospeo's documented filter concepts. Examples: company:{websites:{include:['intercom.com']}}, companyIndustry:{include:['Software Development']}, companyHeadcountCustom:{min:100,max:500}, companyLookalike:{domain:'prospeo.io',minimumTier:'T2'}, companyIntent:{topics:['CRM Software'],activeResearch:true}. Supports the complete documented company filter catalog; nested business options retain their documented meanings. No transport envelope or serialized JSON is required. At least one positive criterion is required; omission means no criterion. Null is accepted only where the chosen business filter documents ignoring or unbounded values.

tags.instructions: Use before `search-people` or `search-companies` when a filter needs canonical values. Choose one category and supply at least two characters. This returns one complete suggestion response, not paginated search records, and is limited to 15 requests per second per account.
